name: skill-concierge
description: A skill-governance layer: semantic retrieval (which skill) + use-enforcement (whether an agent uses one) + a compounding invocation ledger. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Command Code, Oh My Pi, and ZCode.

interface.shortDescription: Semantic skill retrieval + use-enforcement + invocation ledger
interface.longDescription: A skill-governance layer that replaces default skill discovery with precise semantic retrieval, a per-turn use-mandate hook, and a compounding invocation ledger for data-backed always-on curation. Works with both Claude Code and Codex over a single shared catalogue.
defaultPrompt: Find the right skill for this task
